分诊落箱(session `session_01Kktexqp6uVuFMztvvTMf3V`,2026-08-24)。**一句话问题**:一句后来被撤回的技术断言,原样留在五份**已发布**的更新日志里 —— 要不要去改已经发出去的历史记录。

**选项 × 真实代价**:
- **A. 不改,关卡**:源头注释已由 #5673 纠正;发布记录如实保留「当时怎么认为」。业务上 = 更新日志继续可信为「发布当时的记录」,无人被它引导做任何动作。
- **B. 逐行授权加更正注**:照 #9734 先例,五处各加一行「post-publication correction」。代价:动 append-only 记录五处,先例扩大;业务上 = 读旧日志的人多一行提示。

**四棱**:① 长远:append-only 纪律本身比这句话值钱 —— #9734 的授权是针对「教读者跑一条不存在的命令」的**活害**,本句是历史性描述,无活害,先例不应扩大。② 业务拉动:零 —— 没有客户会因这句旧断言做出任何错误动作(它描述的是当时的构建产物对比)。③ 防 AI:批量改 CHANGELOG 正是 #9734 裁决点名的错误工具;A 让「历史记录不许碰」保持为简单可教的规则。④ 创业:零拉动的编辑不做。

**推荐 A(关卡,not planned,源头修正已足)**;回退 B。**置信缺口**:无法测 npm 侧是否有消费者把该句当作现行契约在依赖(byte-identity 承诺若被外部工具断言过,A 的「无活害」前提失效)。回「A」/「B」即可。裁后执行:A ⇒ 关 not planned,理由引本块;B ⇒ 立五行编辑卡带逐行授权引文。

os-decision-facets

一句话问题:#5673 撤回的「dist/index.d.ts 字节同一」空洞测量句,原样留在五份**已发布**的 CHANGELOG 里。改不改已发布的记录?A=不动(源码 docstring 已更正);B=五处各补一行更正注;C=在耐久处(如 `check-changeset-presence.mjs` 头部,本仓惯例位)记录一次更正,五份原文不动。

① **实际业务需求**:零用户影响——npm 上的文本无论如何收不回;风险只是翻旧 release notes 的读者信了一个空洞测量。边际。→ A/C。
② **项目长远合理性**:本仓 CHANGELOG 是 changeset 编译产物——手改编译产物偏离发布管线纪律(B 的实质代价);C 在守卫脚本头记一次,既留下更正痕迹又不动管线。→ C。
③ **防 AI 犯错**:agent 引用这句话作证据的路径主要是**源码 docstring**——那里 #5673 已更正;考古路径(翻 CHANGELOG)由 C 的耐久注记兜住。B 只多覆盖"只读 CHANGELOG 不读别处"的窄场景。→ C。
④ **创业阶段不扩散需求**:A 零成本,C 一段注释,B 五个 append-heavy 文件的 diff。→ A/C。

**推荐:C(四轴同向,A 可接受)。** 裁后执行:C ⇒ 一张 S 级机械卡(守卫头部注记 + 指向 #5673),本卡关;A ⇒ 直接关,理由记录在案。**本分析看不见什么**:您对「已发布记录的事实准确性」的重视程度本身——若您认为发布记录必须逐字可信,B 才是对的,那就接受五文件 diff 的代价。

## Maintainer ruling recorded — **C: record the correction once, durably; released records stand**

Provenance: maintainer, 2026-08-24, live PM chat, verbatim: 「接受你的建议。」 on the aligned four-facet analysis above.

**Ruled:** the five released CHANGELOG entries are not edited (compiled release artifacts stay on the changeset pipeline; npm copies are immutable anyway). The correction is recorded once in a durable, greppable place: the header of `scripts/check-changeset-presence.mjs` (this repo's established home for findings of this shape), stating that the #4580 changeset's "dist/index.d.ts is byte-identical" sentence was a vacuous measurement withdrawn by #5673, with the file list so an archaeologist landing on any of the five copies can find the withdrawal.

This card converts to that S-grade mechanical task. State: `needs-user-decision` → `pm:queue` (ui lane), type Task — closes via the one-comment-block PR.

## ⛔ RULED 2026-08-24 — option C, and the ruling is mostly about what NOT to do

Maintainer, verbatim: **「接受你的建议。」**

**Ruled:** ⛔ the five released CHANGELOG entries are **not edited**. Compiled release artifacts stay on the changeset pipeline, and the npm copies are immutable anyway — a repo-side edit cannot recall what shipped, it only makes the repo disagree with it.

**The deliverable is one durable, greppable record**, in the header of `scripts/check-changeset-presence.mjs` — this repo's established home for findings of this shape. It must state:

- that the #4580 changeset's *"Core's entry surface is unchanged: `dist/index.d.ts` is byte-identical across the change"* sentence was a **vacuous measurement**, withdrawn by #5673;
- **why** it is vacuous — `core/dist/index.d.ts` is emitted from a barrel that only forwards the symbol, so it is byte-identical under any change to a re-exported declaration's shape (PR #5673 proved this with a probe that moved the declaring module's `.d.ts` and left both core files unmoved);
- **the file list**, so an archaeologist who lands on any one of the five copies can find the withdrawal.

The five, per the card: `packages/components/CHANGELOG.md:1472`, `packages/core/CHANGELOG.md:1021`, `packages/plugin-dashboard/CHANGELOG.md:581`, `packages/react/CHANGELOG.md:450`, `packages/types/CHANGELOG.md:705`.

## What makes this an S that still needs judgement

⛔ **Verify the five line references before writing them down.** A correction record whose own pointers are wrong is worse than none — it is the same defect class as the sentence it corrects. The card's search method is good and reusable: `git grep -nI` for the exact sentence, with the known-present control `is byte-identical across the change` (which returned six files — the five plus one unrelated i18n test) and a known-absent control returning exit 1, so an empty result is distinguishable from a broken search. **Re-run it; CHANGELOGs are append-heavy and line numbers move.**

⛔ Do not add a check, a test, or an `UNGATED` entry — the deliverable is a **comment block**. The script's behaviour must not change; say so in the report and show the gate still passes.

A changeset is owed only if `node scripts/check-changeset-presence.mjs` asks for one (an **empty-frontmatter** changeset is this repo's declared "releases nothing" form). Note the mild irony that the gate deciding this is the file you are editing — run it and quote its verdict either way.

Draft PR, `Fixes #5913`. Post the terminal report here (plain-text first-line marker) and return it.

## ACCEPT — PR #6005 (R37, `domain:ui`)

Reviewed against the diff and `origin/main`.

**Checklist:** `Fixes #5913` ✅ · **one file, 51 insertions, 0 deletions, every added line a comment** ✅ · ⛔ no check, no test, no `UNGATED` entry added ✅ · the five released CHANGELOGs **untouched**, per the ruling ✅ · no changeset — the gate being edited says none is owed, quoted from its own verdict ✅.

### The load-bearing claim, verified by me

A correction record whose own pointers are wrong is the *same defect class* as the sentence it corrects, so I re-derived all five rather than accepting them:

```
packages/components/CHANGELOG.md:1472        hit
packages/core/CHANGELOG.md:1021              hit
packages/plugin-dashboard/CHANGELOG.md:581   hit
packages/react/CHANGELOG.md:450              hit
packages/types/CHANGELOG.md:705              hit
```

Known-present control returns **six** files; known-absent control exits 1 with zero lines. Both behave.

✅ **And the sixth hit was judged, not just noted.** `packages/fields/src/__tests__/PercentCellRenderer.locale.test.tsx` also carries the phrase — you established it is an unrelated i18n pin whose byte-identity claim is about *rendered output* and **can genuinely fail**, so it is not a second instance of this defect. Checking whether a stray hit is another instance of the bug is the difference between a search and an answer.

### What lifts this above a transcription

**The record explains the mechanism rather than asserting the verdict.** "Forwarding never restates a shape … only the module that DECLARES the symbol can move" — so the file is byte-identical under *any* change to a re-exported declaration's shape, "including one that breaks every consumer, and a gauge that cannot fail for the change class it is quoted against has discharged nothing." That is the reusable lesson; the withdrawn sentence is just the instance.

**It states that the five copies are NOT edited and that this is a ruling, not an omission** — which is what I asked for, and it is what stops the next reader re-opening it as an oversight and hand-editing compiled release notes.

**And the best line is the one that survives its own rot:**

> Six files means the search worked; zero means it broke, not that the copies are gone.

Line numbers in append-heavy CHANGELOGs decay. Handing the next reader a **re-derivation recipe that is its own control** — rather than five numbers that will be wrong in a month — is the difference between a record and a fossil. That is a better artifact than the ruling strictly required.

### Behaviour-unchanged, proven mechanically

`scripts/__tests__/check-changeset-presence.test.ts` — the dedicated pin on the edited script — still passes 31/31. For a comment-only diff there is no ablation to stage and you said so plainly instead of staging theatre; the pin passing is the mechanical form of the claim. The two pre-insertion byte checks (a grep for a comment-terminator sequence, which this header itself documents as a hazard that closes the block early, and a control-byte scan) are the right paranoia for text going into a block comment.

Nicely circular and correctly handled: the gate deciding whether a changeset is owed **is the file you edited**. You ran it and quoted its verdict either way.

### Landing

Not governed (`scripts/**` is not on the governed path list). Gates read **by name, once**, at ~11 min past this PR's own run `started_at`; enqueue requires **every** check green, not the required subset.
